description: This file defines internal models and data structures related to metadata handling within the Orleans code generator. It includes classes for representing serialization types, invokable interfaces, proxy descriptions, and a compound type alias tree for managing type alias hierarchies.

classes.name: MetadataModel
classes.description: Internal class holding various collections and dictionaries to manage serialization types, invokable interfaces, proxies, and related metadata used during code generation.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasTree
classes.description: Sealed internal class forming a prefix tree (trie) structure for managing compound type aliases. Supports adding, retrieving, and managing nested type alias components.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasComponent
classes.description: Struct representing a component of a compound type alias, which can be a string or an ITypeSymbol, with equality and hash code implementations for use in collections.

classes.name: Either<T, U>
classes.description: Generic struct representing a value that can be either type T or type U, used internally for the CompoundTypeAliasComponent to distinguish between string and type symbols.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the CompoundTypeAliasTree with a root node that has no key or value.

methods.name: GetChildOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the child node associated with the given key if it exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: TryGetChild
methods.description: Tries to get the child node associated with the given key, returning true if found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a sequence of CompoundTypeAliasComponents as a path in the prefix tree with an associated TypeSyntax value.

methods.name: AddInternal
methods.description: Internal method for adding a node with a specific key and optional value to the tree.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new node with an ITypeSymbol key.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new node with a string key.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new node with a string key and associated TypeSyntax value.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new node with an ITypeSymbol key and associated TypeSyntax value.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines whether two CompoundTypeAliasComponent instances are equal based on their underlying value.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the CompoundTypeAliasComponent.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the component, either the string value or the string representation of the type.
